name: App EQ
author: Vocal Monitor
description: Bit-exact port of the app's built-in 10-band graphic EQ. Constant-Q biquad peaking filters at ISO octave centres (31 / 62 / 125 / 250 / 500 / 1k / 2k / 4k / 8k / 16k Hz), Q = 1.4. RBJ cookbook coefficients — identical output to the host's save-time EQ. The canvas mirrors the in-app EqualizerWidget: vertical bars per band, yellow curve through the thumbs, drag horizontally to paint a curve across bands, tap centre to snap that band to 0 dB.
